name: 8x8 Dot Matrix LED Display
description: Like a retro arcade screen! 64 individually addressable bright red LEDs for faces, icons, and text.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a retro arcade screen! 64 individually addressable bright red LEDs for faces, icons, and text.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, DIN (Orange) to Pin 11, CS (Orange) to Pin 10, and CLK (Orange) to Pin 13.
commonMistakes: Powering with 3.3V instead of 5V, leading to dim LEDs and erratic controller sync.

miniExperiment.title: Smiley Face Pixel Matrix
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, DIN to 11, CS to 10, CLK to 13.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The 8x8 LED matrix lights up displaying a bright, smiling monster face.
